484366a818.q: What is Mark Williams-Cook's talk about at MozCon on November 13?
484366a818.a: Mark Williams-Cook is speaking at MozCon on November 13 about making bets on the future of search, covering how AI has increased the amount of levers out of reach when it comes to search rankings, moving from direct page-level control with early search engines like AltaVista to distributed influence through links, user signals, and machine learning models, and now to language distribution where every word on the internet becomes a tiny lever outside individual control.

d118a05387.q: What did ChatGPT 5.6 model update reveal about brand search queries?
d118a05387.a: In ChatGPT 5.6, there was an astronomical spike in site search queries for specific brands that ChatGPT was doing internally, meaning that when users searched for things like 'best video editing software', ChatGPT was already pre-loading and trusting five or six specific brands from its model language distribution, which is unfathomably out of an individual website's control.

bb0cada74f.q: How does ChatGPT use time frames to filter grounding results by freshness?
bb0cada74f.a: ChatGPT sends a time frame window in days specifying how old a result should be during grounding—for example, stock prices require results from the last two days, while AI chat software reviews need content from the last year, with windows going up to 10 years for certain topics. If your content falls outside that date range, it gets snipped from the pipeline and won't make it into final citations even if retrieved.

798cae0062.q: What is the difference between controlling and influencing search levers in the AI era?
798cae0062.a: The debate between people saying 'SEO is dead' versus those optimizing for AI involves a fundamental distinction: lever-pulling tactics like updating keywords or buying links try to control ranking factors directly, whereas influence-based SEO like digital PR and community building work indirectly through language distribution and coverage. With AI, all tactics are now primarily about influence rather than control, as direct page-level levers are increasingly inaccessible.

68ff892c90.q: What is the Fan Out Box Chrome extension and what does it reveal about ChatGPT?
68ff892c90.a: Fan Out Box is a Chrome extension by Saganthan Mahanadasan that allows users to see the background network data happening when doing searches on ChatGPT, revealing variables and grounding mechanisms. This tool helped discover that ChatGPT sends specific time frame windows for different query types, showing whether the system retrieves fresh or older content based on query intent.
